curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a disgruntled former champion cries foul, one investigator must prove whether America's favorite intellectual showdown is an outright backstage illusion.
curatedMovie.description: Herbert Stempel is replaced by highly skilled Charles Van Doren on a cherished game show, then calls it rigged as lawyer Richard Goodwin attempts to uncover the orchestrated deception.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A measured, suspenseful 1950s period drama that demands steady focus as an intricate web of deception slowly unravels.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: A taut, thoughtful historical drama tracking the deception behind a cherished American game show as a lawyer attempts to uncover how it was orchestrated.
